profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Island
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with experience in developing scalable Node.js/Python/Go backends and responsive frontend applications.

My experience includes:
- Web services / microservices / service-oriented architecture
- Building dev tools and static site bundlers
- Migrating complex systems / database administration
- Working with microcontrollers / socket platforms
- Horizontal scaling / database sharding / service orchestration
- Web3, smart-contract development & deployment
- Team leading, onboarding other devs

Skills: Node.js, Python, Golang, C, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB, Docker, Git, GitHub Actions, Kubernetes, Prometheus, REST API Design, React, Webpack, Rollup, Next.js, Nest.js, Astro, Stripe API, Hubspot API, Solidity, Hardhat, Ether.js

positions.title: Senior Founding Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Organized the development process of the company: compiled the tech stack, prioritized features, assigned tasks, tutored other developers.
- Integrated engineering interns into the team, developed a workflow for feature rollouts, conducted pair-programming and code review sessions.
- Developed the entire backend architecture from scratch to manage users and clinics, as well as the testing system allowing doctors to monitor patient treatment progress.
- Created the B2B dashboard application for the clinics to access their patients' and doctors' data.
- Engineered our service-oriented architecture to separate and scale our business logic.
- Setup our CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions, Docker, and Dokku with Azure deployments.
